description: Layer 2a: Temporal knowledge graph — bi-temporal entity/relationship tracking over a live Neo4j. Answers 'when did X become true?' and 'how did Y evolve?' (getzep/graphiti).

neo4j.passwordLocation: host .env (gitignored, 600 perms); the live value currently lives in the neo4j container's NEO4J_AUTH

verified.note: Read-only reachability check via deploy/graphiti/test-connection.sh; no graph data mutated.

llm.purpose: entity + relationship extraction from each episode (required — Graphiti cannot build the graph without an LLM)
llm.notes: Set ONE provider key. The MCP server reads OPENAI_API_KEY by default; for Anthropic set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and MODEL_NAME accordingly. GRAPHITI_LLM_API_KEY is the repo-side env-ref that maps to whichever provider you choose.

mcp.package: getzep/graphiti — mcp_server/ (run via `uv run main.py` or docker compose)
mcp.transport: http (default, http://localhost:8000/mcp/) bridged to Claude Code via mcp-remote, or stdio
mcp.notes: All agents (Claude Code, OpenClaw, pi) point at the SAME Neo4j, so the temporal graph is shared. The graphiti-core Python lib (`pip install graphiti-core`) is the equivalent integration if MCP is not wired.

biTemporal.model: Each fact/edge carries two time axes: when it was TRUE in the world and when the system LEARNED it.

edgeFields.valid_at: when the fact became true in the world
edgeFields.invalid_at: when the fact stopped being true / was superseded (null if still current)

biTemporal.why: Lets the graph answer point-in-time and 'how did this evolve' questions without overwriting history — superseded edges are invalidated, not deleted.

purpose: Phase 10 DoD: the agent can answer 'When did we decide to migrate from Ontraport?' and 'How has Anna's role evolved?' — questions Supermemory (recall) and InfraNodus (topology) can't, because they need the time axis on relationships.
notes: SCAFFOLD ONLY — Neo4j is live, but no LLM key is present so no graph has been built. Two operator steps activate it: (1) put NEO4J_PASSWORD in host .env, (2) add an LLM key (GRAPHITI_LLM_API_KEY → OPENAI_API_KEY or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY). See deploy/graphiti/README.md. Mirrors the documented-integration pattern of memory/supermemory.json and memory/infranodus.json. No real secrets in this file.
